description: Set how often the cold standby is re-copied and verified, from 60 to 10080 minutes, or null to stop. Manage scope. Each drill backs up the primary, restores that copy over the standby in its country, waits for a healthy redeploy and records the verified copy; it never switches traffic. The first drill is one interval away. Hosted MCP requires an account credential without resource confinement.
name: impreza_set_failover_drill_policy
title: Schedule standby drills
